test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends are playing a bottle-spinning game around a circular table, facing the centre. Rohini is sitting third to the left of Rashmi. Rahul is sitting in between Rashmi and Ramesh. Ravi is sitting in between Rohini and Raju. Ravi is sitting second to the right of Rashmi. Who among the following is sitting to the immediate left of Raju?
solution:
Given: Six friends are playing a bottle-spinning game around a circular table, facing the centre. 

1) Rohini is sitting third to the left of Rashmi. 

2) Ravi is sitting second to the right of Rashmi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/defe4b071aecedc9f788146ba79ea4005459ff73f2fc1bbb1067d3ad751387b1.png] 

3) Rahul is sitting in between Rashmi and Ramesh.

4) Ravi is sitting in between Rohini and Raju.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b774b417b1fdf7fc2af6fa35c16faa5ba927c8e40f6b81a2785218d4ba44dba2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Rashmi is sitting to the immediate left of Raju.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
